original.statement: cert-manager 1.17.0 adds more structured logging information to certain log lines, so some log lines have changed format, which may affect operators who filter logs with grep or similar tools.

decision.reason: [ev-95c9a508db46] says a PR added more structured logging information to certain log lines and that "some log lines have changed format". That is a change in output semantics with no configuration change, so behavior-changed fits. No subject family is specific to log output, so protocol-behavior is the closest fit. The name "log-line-format" is short, kebab-case and built from the excerpt's own words. The excerpt doesn't name specific components or log lines, so leaving out a component is correct.
